[EN] (Even unpowered, the dark pressure of the dementalith is suffocating.)
[ES] (Incluso sin energía, la oscura presión del dementalito es sofocante.)

[EN] The dark energy arising from the Dementalith is suffocating. Even though Thulsa is gone, the power of the Dementalith still remains as strong as ever. Investigate more closely.The power of the Dementalith is becoming stronger.
[ES] La energía oscura que emana del Dementalith es sofocante. Aunque Thulsa se haya ido, el poder del Dementalith sigue siendo tan fuerte como siempre. Investigate more closely.The power of the Dementalith is becoming stronger.
